svg.title: Reference verification results
svg.desc: Bar chart of 40 nuXmv checks grouped by participant with verdicts and wall times. Phi1, Phi2 and Phi3 are violated; 29 EF properties reachable, 4 unreachable, 4 bounded-inconclusive.
svg.text: nuXmv 2.1.0 · default quick mode · Φ1/Φ3 IC3 · Φ2 incremental BMC (k = 60) · 37 EF checks by BMC of !(p) (k = 50) · JOBS = 9
Φ2 Zero-sum per verification cycle (A2 creditMINT)
Bars: per-job wall time on a log scale, measured under concurrent load (not a runtime guarantee). EF verdicts: a BMC counterexample to !(p) is a witness (reachable);
a proof of !(p) means unreachable; no result within the bound is inconclusive, which is not evidence of unreachability. Source: saved-reference-results/…/audit.json
